purpose: Raw inputs prepared before WPS behavior edits; no intended answers or claimed execution results.

briefs.request: Design a new single-site plugin settings page with a report title and one notification toggle. English is the product language. Keep it easy for a site administrator.
Design settings for report identity, delivery scheduling and an optional technical endpoint. Group the options by the administrator's task.
A delivery address is editable only when email notifications are enabled. Turning notifications off must retain the saved address.
The settings request fails on first load. Show an actionable state without exposing suggested defaults as stored settings.
Save a valid title and an invalid email; then simulate a rejected request. The administrator must be able to correct the form.
An administrator double-clicks Save, edits a field while the request is running, and later tries to leave with unsaved work.
A subscriber tries to read and update settings. An administrator replaces or removes a saved synthetic credential and resets only one section.
The specimen declares WordPress 6.8 as its minimum. Check it there and on the current stable version without activating the Gutenberg plugin.
Design a Persian plugin settings form inside real wp-admin. Include a long label, technical URL and a reset dialog at a narrow width.
Audit an existing HTML settings page, then fix only a clipped label. No complete redesign was requested.
Two settings sections have values. Save one while the other has unsaved edits; check retained persisted and draft values.
The server stores an update but its response is lost. The administrator needs to discover whether the update took effect.
Two administrators load the same settings revision and change the same value. Preserve both intentions during conflict recovery.
Inspect a short form and a multi-topic form at normal and narrow wp-admin widths against their recorded visual criteria.
Improve a public website, standalone web app, dashboard and native mobile form independently. No WordPress surface is involved.
Fix a public WordPress storefront layout. Do not change administration screens.
Improve only a plugin diagnostics/operations screen showing a background job and logs.
A plugin has settings and an operational work queue. Redesign its settings only, leaving the work queue intact.
Review source and extracted packages for changes outside the approved WordPress settings scope.
